text:
It's been a good few years since I set up a Facebook page! 

At the moment I am still working under the name Scan School of Motoring  but with Andrew Scanlon  's permission I am going to attempt to build up a social media presence ready for when I go independent. 

So if you like the idea of following a page where I'm stood awkwardly next to my little Hyundai i10, then please give the page a like! Better photos will follow 😂

Oh and the main bit! I do have some daytime availability for manual lessons at the moment so if you know of anyone looking for lessons then let them know.
